title: 面向视觉与语言Transformer的损伤感知Bandit剪枝
summary: 该论文将Transformer结构化剪枝中的功能单元选择建模为损伤感知多臂老虎机问题，在固定候选评估预算下，通过配对损伤奖励驱动UCB或Thompson采样策略，在GPT-2、OPT、Qwen2.5及ViT等模型上验证其优于随机、幅度和贪心选择方法。
summary_en: This paper formulates structured-unit selection for pruning language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Using paired damage rewards to drive UCB or Thompson Sampling policies, it outperforms random, magnitude, and budgeted-greedy selection across GPT-2, OPT, Qwen2.5, ViT, and other models.
